schema.title: Response List Agents Api V1 Agents Get

post.description:
Structured incidents are validated deterministically against the twin. Free-text reports
are stored verbatim (untrusted) and await SENTINEL analysis (Phase 3).
Start the agent workflow (SENTINEL -> CARTOGRAPHER -> ORACLE) in the background.

get.description: Synthetic basemap (GeoJSON FeatureCollection) for the fictional district.

schema.title: Response Get Basemap Api V1 Infrastructure Basemap Get

get.description: Structural criticality by exact N-1 simulation; single points of failure flagged.

post.description: Record a new inventory version (existing strategies keep referencing their version).
Return the operational picture to the baseline. History is kept (append-only).

schema.title: Response List Strategies Api V1 Recovery Strategies Get

post.description:
Plan three strategies (new planning round) and validate them with GUARDIAN's rules.
Normally invoked by the agent workflow (STRATEGIST + GUARDIAN).

get.description: The latest planning round for an incident, with the no-action baseline for comparison.

post.description: Run GUARDIAN's deterministic rules (V-001..V-009) against the stored strategy.

schema.title: Response List Scenarios Api V1 Scenarios Get

post.description: Run a deterministic simulation synchronously and persist it (immutable).

schema.title: Response Get Simulation Events Api V1 Simulations  Simulation Id  Events Get

post.description: Re-run with identical inputs and compare result hashes (reproducibility check).

schema.title: Response List Workflows Api V1 Workflows Get

post.description: Answer SENTINEL's question: confirm the damaged facilities (validated against the twin).

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: a `workflow` snapshot on connect and after every change; the stream
ends after a terminal status. Clients may fall back to polling GET /workflows/{id}.
